name: Gentek Reg Agent
description:
Gentek Reg-Agent helps financial services teams answer regulatory reporting questions faster inside Claude.
It brings regulatory validation rules, reporting fields, error codes and reference data into the workflow teams already use. Instead of searching manually through regulator spreadsheets, rulebooks and technical specifications, users can ask practical questions about reporting requirements, field formats, instruments, ISINs, LEIs and legal entities.
Responses are grounded in authoritative source material, helping reporting, operations, compliance and control teams work faster while maintaining traceability.
Regulatory reporting intelligence across multiple jurisdictions and reporting regimes, sourced from official regulatory and industry documentation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Gentek Reg Agent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Gentek Reg Agent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gentekai.com/reg-mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Gentek Reg Agent MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gentek Reg Agent provides these MCP tools: list_regulation_fields, search_eu_emir_validation_rules, search_eu_mifir_validation_rules, search_eu_sftr_validation_rules, search_reference_data, search_uk_emir_validation_rules, search_uk_mifir_validation_rules, search_uk_sftr_validation_rules, search_asic_validation_rules, search_cftc_validation_rules, search_csa_validation_rules, and search_hkma_validation_rules.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Gentek Reg Agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Gentek Reg Agent in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Gentek Reg Agent MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gentek Reg Agent requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Gentek Reg Agent is developed by Gentek.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
